name: OTRS
description_en:
OTRS is a configurable service-management platform with a Customer Service & Support solution connecting requests, customers, contracts, equipment and appointments. Its current solution describes repair, maintenance, customer registration and field-service workflows, with a customer portal and optional AI services. Managed and on-premises operating models divide implementation and maintenance responsibility differently.

An evaluation should trace one repair from reported equipment through warranty, ownership, service targets and dispatch. The current commercial offer uses licensed users, a base package and extras; it should not be confused with the old end-of-life Community Edition. This profile is based on public documentation; no tenant, process, SLA, migration, database or purchase was tested.
description_zh:
OTRS 是可配置服务管理平台，其Customer Service & Support方案连接请求、客户、合同、设备及预约。当前方案描述维修、维护、客户注册及现场服务流程，配有客户门户及可选AI服务。托管与本地运行模式对实施及维护责任划分不同。

评估应将一次维修从所报设备追踪到保修、归属、服务目标及派工。当前商业方案采用许可用户数、基础套餐和附加项，不能与旧的已终止维护Community Edition混淆。本文基于公开文档，未测试租户、流程、SLA、迁移、数据库或购买。

faq.question_en: Does closing a ticket prove the repair is complete?
faq.question_zh: 关闭工单就证明维修已完成吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The solution timer treats closed status as solved. Repair completion, warranty evidence and customer acceptance need their own checks.
faq.answer_zh: 不能，解决时钟以关闭状态视为解决。维修完成、保修依据及客户验收需另行检查。

faq.question_en: Is the current offer the old free Community Edition?
faq.question_zh: 当前方案是旧免费Community Edition吗？
faq.answer_en: No. The official site separates current licensed packages from the end-of-life6.xCommunity Edition and offers migration discussion. Exact commercial license terms were not fully reviewed.
faq.answer_zh: 不是，官网将当前许可套餐与已终止维护6.x Community Edition分开，并提供迁移沟通。准确商业许可条款未完整核查。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: Trace the equipment and contract through one repair
sections.title_zh: 在一次维修中追踪设备与合同
sections.en:
The current customer-service solution is broader than a generic inbox: it links requests with machines/configuration items, contracts, appointments and a customer portal. Its written repair example goes from damage documentation through cost estimation and warranty checking to dispatch. These steps create a useful evaluation sequence, not proof a deployed system performs them correctly.

Use one illustrative machine incident and inspect how its customer ID, affected equipment, warranty and assigned team are selected. Then test missing equipment, expired warranty and a changed visit. Preconfigured forms do not establish authoritative ERP data or a technician’s actual availability. Published speed, satisfaction and service-compliance claims remain vendor statements.
sections.zh:
当前客服方案比通用收件箱范围更广，将请求连接至机器／配置项、合同、预约及客户门户。书面维修示例从损坏记录经过估价、保修核对到派工。这些步骤可作评估顺序，不能证明真实系统正确执行。

应使用一个假设机器事件，检查客户ID、受影响设备、保修和团队如何选择，再测试设备缺失、保修过期和预约变更。预配置表单不能证明ERP资料权威或技术人员实际有空。公开速度、满意度及服务履约主张仍属厂商陈述。

sections.title_en: Understand what actually stops each clock
sections.title_zh: 理解每个时钟实际结束条件
sections.en:
The SLA guide requires configured services and enabled service/SLA settings. Calendars define counted working time. A first-response target ends on an agent article visible to the customer, and is not triggered for an agent-created ticket. Update time resets on visible agent output and the first customer response, not every later customer message. Solution time uses closed status and does not reset when reopened.

SLA escalation values override queue values. Alerts also depend on preferred-queue and escalation-notification settings, so setting a timer alone does not establish delivery to the responsible person. The guide warns about more than fifty valid SLAs and allows deactivation rather than deletion. Compare the configured clock with customer-visible elapsed time and completion evidence; no timer was run.
sections.zh:
SLA指南要求已配置服务并启用服务／SLA设置，日历定义计入工作时段。首响目标在坐席发布客户可见文章时结束，坐席创建的工单不触发首响。更新时钟在可见坐席输出及客户首次回应时重置，并非之后每条客户消息都重置。解决时钟采用关闭状态，重开不会重置。

SLA升级值覆盖队列值。通知还依赖偏好队列及升级通知设置，因此设定时钟不表示负责人收到。指南警告超过50个有效SLA，并允许停用而非删除。应将配置计时与客户可见经过时间及完成证据比较；此次未运行计时。

sections.title_en: Decide which backend owns customer-company data
sections.title_zh: 确定哪个后端拥有客户公司资料
sections.en:
OTRS requires a customer ID and can use its database or an external customer backend. The January2026 guide says local company creation/editing works with the database backend; using an external directory such as LDAP disables that management. The first thousand listed records are not a total-customer limit. Customer companies are marked invalid rather than deleted in this screen.

For on-premises configuration, the guide distinguishes customer configuration from default files that upgrades overwrite. Managed customers instead involve the Customer Solutions team. Treat backend ownership and upgrade behavior as implementation work, not a promise that every field can be edited in a browser. No configuration file or database was changed.
sections.zh:
OTRS要求客户ID，可使用自身数据库或外部客户后端。2026年1月指南称，本地公司创建／编辑适用于数据库后端，使用LDAP等外部目录会关闭该管理能力。列表前1000条不是客户总数上限，客户公司在该界面中标无效而非删除。

本地配置指南区分客户配置文件与升级会覆盖的默认文件，托管客户则联系Customer Solutions团队。后端权威及升级行为属于实施工作，不能承诺每个字段都能在浏览器编辑。此次未修改配置文件或数据库。

sections.title_en: Separate managed responsibility from on-premises control
sections.title_zh: 区分托管责任与本地控制
sections.en:
The current comparison assigns hardware, system operation, manual patches and recovery resources to the on-premises operator. Managed service describes maintained application components, updates and backups, with package-specific assistance and vendor coordination for changes. Its advertised default German hosting and requested US/Canada options are not a verified complete residency/subprocessor guarantee.

The current official Community Edition page says6.x is end-of-life with no official security fixes or maintenance. Modern OTRS is offered separately with migration discussions. A migration sandbox or consultancy offer does not demonstrate data, workflows, permissions or customizations transferred successfully. Verify an actual export, restore and process comparison before switching; none was performed here.
sections.zh:
当前对照将硬件、系统运营、手动修补及恢复资源归于本地运营者。托管服务描述维护应用组件、更新和备份，协助及变更由已购套餐和厂商协调决定。宣传默认德国托管、可申请美国／加拿大，不等于完整驻留／子处理方保证已核实。

当前官方Community Edition页称6.x已终止生命周期，不再有官方安全修复或维护。现代OTRS另售并讨论迁移。迁移沙箱或咨询方案不能证明资料、工作流、权限或定制已成功迁入。切换前应验证实际导出、恢复及流程对照；此次未执行。

sections.title_en: Quote the current package rather than old plan names
sections.title_zh: 按当前套餐报价而非沿用旧档名
sections.en:
The current purchase page configures licensed-user amount, Starter/Advanced/Pro and optional extras. Starter lists ticketing, workflows and one thousand assets; Advanced adds Kanban, web services and a test system; Pro lists unlimited assets,24x7 support,12,000AI credits and an EV Reach user license. The public page does not establish a numeric subscription price or a universal concurrent-user metric.

AI credits, storage, assets, SMS, enablement and on-premises services can add scope. Premium Services are now presented as Enable/Use/Expand with included service categories. Confirm user definition, credit period and consumption, interfaces, training, response commitments and deployment operations in the quote. Full legal license, exact export guarantees, UI-language coverage and regional purchase remain unverified.
sections.zh:
当前购买页配置许可用户数、Starter／Advanced／Pro及可选项。Starter列工单、工作流和1000资产；Advanced增加Kanban、webservices及测试系统；Pro列无限资产、24×7支持、12000AI积分和EV Reach用户许可。公开页未确定数字订阅价或通用并发用户口径。

AI积分、存储、资产、SMS、启用和本地服务会增加范围。高级服务目前按Enable／Use／Expand及所含服务类别呈现。报价需确认用户定义、积分周期与消耗、接口、培训、响应承诺和部署运维。完整法律许可、准确导出保证、界面语言覆盖及地区购买未核实。
